label: AI Automation Engineering
about: Finds the repetitive back-office work a business still does by hand, from what its website shows: enquiries by plain email, paper intake forms, phone-only scheduling, no FAQ, no online payment, and admin roles being hired. Each gap is a workflow you could build in n8n. It reads public pages only; a 'no' means 'nothing found on the site', so confirm in the first conversation.

checks.label: Is hiring for admin or desk roles
look_for: (?:we'?re hiring|now hiring|join our team|open positions?|job openings?|career opportunit\w+|current openings?)\W[^.]{0,150}?(?P<q1>administrative assistant|admin assistant|office (?:manager|administrator|assistant)|receptionist|front desk (?:coordinator|assistant|associate|agent)|data entry|scheduler|dispatcher|customer service (?:rep|representative|agent)|billing (?:clerk|specialist)|intake coordinator)

(?P<q2>administrative assistant|admin assistant|office (?:manager|administrator|assistant)|receptionist|front desk (?:coordinator|assistant|associate|agent)|data entry|scheduler|dispatcher|customer service (?:rep|representative|agent)|billing (?:clerk|specialist)|intake coordinator)[^.]{0,60}\b(?:apply|job description|full[- ]time|part[- ]time|position)
checks.gap_line: you're hiring for desk work ({quote}), which is often repeat tasks that can be done for you automatically

checks.label: Booking or scheduling online
look_for: book (online|now|an appointment|your|a)|schedule (online|now|an appointment|a call|a consultation|a visit)|request (an )?appointment|appointment request
checks.gap_line: there's no online scheduling, so every appointment is arranged back and forth by phone or email

checks.label: Intake done with downloadable forms
look_for: (?P<q1>(?:download|print|printable)(?: out)?(?: and (?:print|fill(?: out)?))?(?: the| our| a| your| these| this| new| patient| client| customer| intake| registration| application)* ?(?:forms?|paperwork|packets?))\b
checks.gap_line: new clients download a form, fill it in and send it back ({quote}), so someone has to retype it by hand

checks.missing: Enquiries by plain email or phone only
checks.label: A real enquiry form on the site
checks.gap_line: enquiries come in by plain email or phone, so nothing is captured, sorted or answered automatically

checks.label: FAQ or help page
look_for: faq|frequently asked|common questions|help (center|centre)|knowledge ?base|support (center|centre)|how it works|questions (and|&) answers
checks.gap_line: there's no FAQ or help page, so the same questions are answered by hand again and again

checks.label: Chat, text or WhatsApp on the site
checks.gap_line: there's no chat or instant reply on the site, so questions asked out of hours wait until someone is back

checks.label: Pay online or client portal
look_for: pay (online|now|your (bill|invoice|balance))|make a payment|online payment|client portal|customer portal|patient portal|account login|my account|member login
checks.gap_line: there's no way to pay or check an invoice online, so billing and chasing payments is done by hand

checks.label: Email sign-up for follow-up
checks.gap_line: there's no email sign-up, so past customers are never followed up automatically

checks.missing: Already shows automation or AI tools ({quote})
checks.label: Already uses automation or AI tools

opener: Hi {business} team, I was looking at how businesses in {city} handle day-to-day admin and noticed {gap_line}. That's usually a few hours a week of copy-and-paste that can be done for you automatically. I mapped how I'd set it up (one diagram, no cost to you); want me to send it?
